snippet.title: Rotted: A Brain Rot Simulator - Official Animated Trailer | Steam Next Fest Demo
snippet.description:
The loop is infinite. Nobody ever leaves the room. 

🔥 PLAY THE FREE DEMO ON STEAM NOW

By 2030, the global economy collapsed into absolute poverty. Then came Potatron. 

A general intelligence powered by gene-edited potato starch. To keep the population fed, it distributes a mandatory basic income. 

The catch? You have to scroll the short-form feed. Forever.

Watch the official animated cinematic announcement trailer for Rotted: A Brain Rot Simulator, live right now for Steam Next Fest 2026! 

You are fueling the very monster that is building your cage... but you need to pay rent. Manage your real-world sanity, swat bugs, fight a dying phone battery, and unlock unhinged societal archetypes to optimize your scrolling. 

Are the rumors true? Is there an exit door hidden deep in the data logs, or is the door just another layer of the algorithm? 

WISHLIST ROTTED ON STEAM
